complete_elapsed.limitations: Only three paired trials; resampling cannot establish broad hardware or workload generality. Updates within trials are not independent repetitions.

comparison.memory_scope: Original criterion concerns >=6GiB lower complete training device-process peaks for every seed. Reported NVML peaks are sampled lower bounds; allocator savings are a separate measure. No universal speed threshold is inferred.

updates_1_300.limitations: Only three paired trials; resampling cannot establish broad hardware or workload generality. Updates within trials are not independent repetitions.

updates_31_300.limitations: Only three paired trials; resampling cannot establish broad hardware or workload generality. Updates within trials are not independent repetitions.

updates_6_30.limitations: Only three paired trials; resampling cannot establish broad hardware or workload generality. Updates within trials are not independent repetitions.

limitations: All three predeclared controlled seeds 17/42/123 and both precisions are retained, with rank16/alpha32/LR1e-4; these are separate from the pending selected-rank32 best-fit confirmation.
The 584-row development split was exposed during candidate selection. Reusing baseline seed42 is predeclared; three-seed uncertainty does not turn these rows into untouched final data.
Both bootstrap methods fail the unchanged 2% one-sided upper NLL margin; accuracy preservation and adaptation gain pass. The original 256-row NLL failure remains a separate negative result.
Complete-experiment elapsed confidence intervals cross parity. Per-update timing must not be advertised as end-to-end training or lifecycle speedup.
External device/process and host values are sampled lower bounds; historical incomplete PSS and missing narrow-interval samples are preserved. No old sample is repaired by later collector changes.
Configured max_length4096 and8 temporal slots do not prove long-context training or8 unique source frames. This run has no complete actual training-shape telemetry.

Recovery tests establish exact next update3 and final update4 after resuming explicit committed update2, including mid-accumulation interruption. They do not establish interruption/resume at update300.
Only aggregate quality, all emitted choice-count/gold-letter slices, and source hashes are projected. Private per-row influence IDs are excluded; task-template descriptive analysis is separate.
Checkpoint sizes were measured on the original filesystem; this metadata projector does not read tensor payloads. Allocation CPU core-hours are accounting costs, not process-resident host memory.

crossed_group_sensitivity.method: paired seeds then shared recording-group draw

hierarchical_primary.method: paired seeds then independent within-seed recording-group draws

limitations: Three training seeds and few recording groups give limited uncertainty resolution.
Whole-group pairing cannot establish independence beyond available recording metadata.
Frozen predictions are a fixed deterministic reference, not additional independent training seeds.
Development and exposed regression outcomes cannot establish untouched final quality.
Artifact identity, recovery, memory and task-scope gates are separate requirements.
Slice intervals are exploratory, unadjusted for multiple comparisons and never used for selection.

timing_scope.complete_elapsed_seconds: Starts after reading the experiment specification and creating its output directory, before build/kernel-receipt verification and provenance hashing. Includes disposable preflight, native 300-update training, adapter publication, fresh-process DCP and portable probes, exact reload comparison, development 584-row scoring, orchestration and sampler teardown. Includes source verification inside child stages.
timing_scope.excluded_from_complete_elapsed: The separate four-update interruption/recovery qualification is excluded and reported per case; scheduler wait, outer-driver/container startup and allocation residual are reported separately.
timing_scope.external_memory: Sampler starts after disposable preflight. Whole measured experiment peaks exclude preflight and the separately executed four-update recovery qualifier. Process RSS/PSS does not measure unmapped filesystem page cache.
timing_scope.native_update_windows: Per-update timers are separately reported; they do not include complete validation, checkpoint, source verification or evaluation costs.
timing_scope.training_stage: Includes source verification, process setup, frozen-base construction, initial and scheduled 64-row validation, 300 updates, checkpoint writes and teardown.
